categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Cowin Biotech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in molecular diagnostics, focusing on core molecular detection technologies including raw material enzymes, nucleic acid preservation reagents, nucleic acid extraction and purification reagents, and molecular diagnostic kits. The company also provides molecular detection services and technology services, with a business layout covering core raw material enzymes, reagent kits, and detection services. It has expanded into digestive tract diseases and respiratory infectious disease screening and diagnosis.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed six core technology platforms: raw material enzymes, nucleic acid preservation, nucleic acid extraction and purification, quantitative fluorescent PCR, gene sequencing, and nucleic acid mass spectrometry. It employs advanced protein engineering, fermentation purification, seamless cloning, and freeze-drying technologies. Production is managed under ISO13485:2016 quality management system with automated and integrated manufacturing processes, including K/3 production planning and barcode tracking systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include molecular diagnostic reagent manufacturers, research institutions, hospitals, third-party medical laboratories, pharmaceutical companies, and CROs. The company serves domestic and international markets, providing products and services for clinical diagnostics, scientific research, and industrial applications. Major end markets include digestive tract disease screening, respiratory infectious disease diagnosis, and molecular biology research.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with marketing centers in major domestic regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, and Greater Bay Area, and expanding coverage in Fujian, Sichuan, Chongqing, Henan, Shandong, Shaanxi, and Northeast China. It also has overseas marketing centers in the US, Europe, South America, Southeast Asia, Middle East, and Africa, with subsidiaries and sales offices in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Wuhan, and Taizhou.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cowin Biotech operates mainly in the upstream and midstream segments of the molecular diagnostics supply chain, producing core raw material enzymes and reagents, as well as diagnostic kits. It also extends downstream by providing molecular detection services and technology services, thus covering the full value chain from raw materials to end diagnostic services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes high-intensity R&D investment focusing on innovation in molecular detection core raw materials, nucleic acid preservation, extraction, and diagnostic reagents. It prioritizes development of rapid, sensitive, and stable enzymes and reagents, with ongoing projects in digestive tract and respiratory disease diagnostics, including novel PCR and sequencing technologies. It also invests in automation, digital marketing, and global market expansion, supported by a strong R&D team led by industry experts.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of molecular detection raw material enzymes, nucleic acid preservation and extraction reagents, and molecular diagnostic kits. Additional income comes from molecular detection services provided to medical institutions and research organizations, as well as technology services including advanced sequencing platforms. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales and supplemented by distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic innovator in molecular diagnostics with a comprehensive product portfolio and strong upstream raw material enzyme production capabilities. It competes with international giants like Thermo Fisher, Qiagen, Roche, and Illumina, particularly in raw material enzymes and diagnostic reagents. Cowin Biotech has broken import monopolies in certain product categories and is recognized for its technological advancements and participation in national standards development.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 125.9 million, a 26.54% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -157.2 million, reflecting an 86.25% decline. R&D expenses increased by 12.43% to RMB 99.2 million, accounting for 78.84% of revenue. Total assets stood at RMB 1.62 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.47 billion, both declining year-over-year. The company maintains a sizable workforce of 833 employees, including 230 in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cowin Biotech differentiates itself through its vertically integrated molecular diagnostics platform, self-developed core raw material enzymes with performance matching or exceeding imported products, and comprehensive product lines covering all molecular detection stages. It offers high-quality, cost-effective solutions, including innovative nucleic acid preservation technologies and rapid diagnostic kits for digestive and respiratory diseases. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and active role in industry standards position it as a trusted partner for domestic and international customers.
